ORDER 

By the Commission: 

On June 1, 2026, Miros Mechanical Services, Inc. (“Petitioner”) filed a verified 
Petition with the Illinois Commerce Commission (“Commission”) seeking to cancel its 
Certificate of Service Authority to install energy efficiency measures pursuant to Section 
16-128B of the Public Utilities Act (“Act”). 220 ILCS 5/1-101 et seq. 

Petitioner was granted a Certificate of Service Authority in Docket No. 19-0360. 
Petitioner requests that the certificate granted in Docket No. 19-0360 be cancelled. 
Commission Staff did not participate, nor were any petitions to intervene filed. Since all 
facts necessary for the Commission to grant the requested relief are contained in the 
Petitioner, no hearing is necessary. 

The Commission, having considered the entire record herein and being fully 
advised in the premises, is of the opinion and find that: 
(1) 
Petitioner, Miros Mechanical Services, Inc., was granted a Certificate of 
Service Authority to install energy efficiency measures pursuant to the 
requirements of the Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 462; 
(2) 
the Commission has jurisdiction over Petitioner and the subject matter of 
this Petition; 
(3) 
the recitals of fact set forth in prefatory portion of this Order are supported 
by the record and here by adopted as findings of fact; 
(4) 
insofar as the service Petitioner offered in Illinois is offered by other energy 
efficient installers, cancellation of Petitioner’s Certificate of Service 
Authority will not deprive Illinois residents of any necessary service and is 
not otherwise contrary to the public interest; and 
(5) 
the Petition should be granted. 
IT IS THEREFORE ORDERED by the Illinois Commerce Commission that the 
Petition of Milos Mechanical Services, Inc. to cancel its Certificate of Service Authority 
previously issued in Docket No. 19-0360 is granted.

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that pursuant to Section 10-113(a) of the Public 
Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, any application for rehearing shall be filed 
within 30 days after service of the Order on the party. 

IT IS FURTHER ORDERED that subject to the provisions of Section 10-113 of the 
Public Utilities Act and 83 Ill. Adm. Code 200.880, this Order is final; it is not subject to 
the Administrative Review Law. 

By Order of the Commission this 1st day of July, 2026 

(SIGNED) DOUGLAS P. SCOTT 

Chairman
